name: personal-memory
description: Capture and recall long-horizon personal memory from any project. Bundles the store's seven skills — log-memory (capture, always the default graph), recall-memory, recall-graph, promote-graph (user-confirmed promotion into named shared graphs), manage-graphs (graphs + distribution rules), pull-memories, compact-tags — which drive the local `memory` CLI in your personal-memory clone (set MEMORY_HOME to point at it).
